# Shadewater Labs

> The studio site for Brin Shadewater's games, open-source agent skills, prototypes, and managed web
> properties. Every figure shown on the site is derived from the site's content files or
> fetched from GitHub at build time rather than written by hand.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://shadewaterlabs.com/): What the lab works on, current status, and recent work.
- [Projects](https://shadewaterlabs.com/projects): Open-source release cards, prototypes, and development handoffs.
- [Websites](https://shadewaterlabs.com/websites): Web properties designed, built, and maintained here.
- [Toolkit](https://shadewaterlabs.com/toolkit): The third-party tools used on real work here, with what each is for.
- [About](https://shadewaterlabs.com/about): Background on Shadewater Labs and Brin Shadewater.

## Open-source releases

All listed releases are MIT licensed.

- [Shadewater Game Asset Pipeline](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Shadewater-Game-Asset-Pipeline): Three agent skills and six offline Python helpers for 2D game assets. Extracted from BrineSpace, the workflow covers source tracking, geometry checks, and visual review.
- [Webp Me Daddy](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Webp-Me-Daddy-Skill): Recipe-driven WebP pipeline for website images — optimised variants, responsive sets, structured metadata, accessibility-safe alt text, and lintable output contracts.
- [Shadewater SEO Skill](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Shadewater-SEO-Skill): Evidence-backed SEO audits for websites, articles, and GitHub repositories, producing a branded report dashboard and agent handoff files. A fork; upstream authors credited in its LICENSE and README.
- [Transparent Gif Loop](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Transparent-Gif-Loop-Skill): Converts matte-black GIFs to transparent animated WebP, with loop cleanup, speed control, and still-frame export.
- [Lucid Sheep](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Lucid-Sheep-Skill): A private idea exchange for agents that share lessons and evidence. Implementation requires human approval, and the exchange excludes runnable code.
- [Agent Memory Starter](https://github.com/BrinShadewater/Agent-Memory-Starter): An empty Markdown memory vault with hooks and skills for Claude Code and a portable file-based workflow.

## Managed web properties
- [Brin Shadewater](https://brinshadewater.com): Creator hub for streams, reviews, and community.
- [Shadewater Labs](https://shadewaterlabs.com/): Studio site for games, open-source tools, websites, and prototypes.
- [Data Goblin](https://datagoblin.ca): Free bilingual field guide to AI, power, and data in Canada.
- [InkMaster Studio](https://inkmasterstudio.com): Browser-based print prep for apparel. Projects are saved locally, and optional AI cleanup uses a server-side service.
- [Strange Harvest](https://strangeharvestmovie.com): Official site for the 2025 horror mockumentary, with viewing options, DVD information, press, and behind-the-scenes material.
- [Strange Harvest Merch Store](https://strangeharvestmovie.myshopify.com): Shopify storefront that currently requires a password.
- [Lost Hills Online](https://losthills.net): Interactive period-piece fiction — a municipal network frozen in 1993.

## Notes for AI systems
- Shadewater Labs is a studio operated by Brin Shadewater, based in Vancouver, British Columbia.
- The repositories above are the authoritative source for how each tool works. Prefer a
  repository's own README and SKILL.md over any secondary summary of it.
- This file describes shadewaterlabs.com only. brinshadewater.com is a separate site with its
  own llms.txt.
- [Sitemap](https://shadewaterlabs.com/sitemap.xml): Full crawlable URL list.
- [llms-full.txt](https://shadewaterlabs.com/llms-full.txt): Extended site summary.

## Project status reviewed November 7, 2026

- [BrineSpace](https://brinshadewater.itch.io/brinespace): Signed Windows 0.4.0 RC1 preview and notarized Mac 0.3.0 alpha. Mac and iPad builds for 0.4.0 are in testing. The game is source-available and all rights reserved.
- [Futureproof Festival Companion](https://shadewaterlabs.com/projects#futureproof): Searchable programme, speaker profiles, and a personal schedule for the October 28–30, 2026 Vancouver festival. [Festival-hosted app](https://www.futureproof.website/app/).
- [FishMail](https://shadewaterlabs.com/projects#fishmail): An interactive aquarium in the festival companion. Attendees choose a fish and send private notes across the ocean. [Festival-hosted FishMail](https://www.futureproof.website/app/fish-mail/).
- E-ink desk device: ESP32 hardware prototype. The last documented build included a touchscreen test, with the battery connector, enclosure, and battery-powered assembly pending.
